notes.evidence: Real author checkpoint on CPU, populated specimen output and empty blank control. See src/probe/reports/2026-09-30-format-expansion/mothbot/report.json for exact invocation and scope. This is a format probe, not an accuracy evaluation. Runs the original _save_result after OBB inference; excludes thumbnail generation, blur enrichment and later pipeline stages.
notes.scope: Fresh detection-stage output for the PyTorch OBB path. Later identification/manual editing/tracking can change labels and add fields; this profile does not describe those later stages or the separate ONNX writer. The null-only group_id and imageData describe this writer, which does not populate grouping or embed image bytes. Supporting those features requires a separately evidenced extension. The rotation literal and four point positions define this OBB representation, rather than defaults for arbitrary annotation shapes.
notes.coordinates: points contains four [x,y] vertices in original-image pixels. direction is cv2.minAreaRect angle in degrees, not the YOLO internal rotation in radians.
notes.confidence: score and confidence_detection duplicate the OBB confidence in [0,1] when first written. The detector initializes label to creature and does not export model class IDs; label contents are not constrained to that initial value.
notes.identity: version and detector_bot contain the model name, not a schema version. imagePath is the supplied image path. patch_path is a precomputed filename when thumbnails are enabled, otherwise an empty string; thumbnail existence is a separate step.
notes.timestamp: timestamp_detection uses local YYYY-MM-DD__HH_MM_SS_(+HHMM), not the schema ISO type.
notes.constants: kie_linking is initially []; flags and attributes are initially {}. The detector initializes difficult to the string false, not a boolean; the schema allows other string contents. Empty detections yield shapes=[].
notes.optional: The asynchronous patch writer can add blur_score, motion_streak and blur_method; these are source-inspected optional enrichment, not required fields from _save_result.
notes.initial_values: The detection writer initializes image and shape descriptions, identifier_bot and identifier_human to empty strings. These are initialization defaults, not restrictions on string contents; the schema permits populated values. This does not establish coverage of every later pipeline field or variant.
notes.conversion: ISIR preserves the oriented center/width/height box with angle in radians, counterclockwise in bottom-left coordinates, plus the four-corner polygon. Native angles and labels/classes remain metadata. COCO exports an axis-aligned envelope bbox and polygon segmentation. No area is inferred.
